title: Tee Higgins, Amon-Ra St. Brown each fined four times for obscene gestures, illegal celebrations

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Tee Higgins, Amon-Ra St. Brown each fined four times for obscene gestures, illegal celebrations
sources.description: We learned during the week that Bengals wide receivers Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins were fined for gestures deemed to be obscene by the league office, but it turns out that both players were fined multiple times.
